question: Which bowler has the lowest bowling average per wicket taken?
sql:
-- Sachin Baby bowled 6 balls, conceded 8 runs, took 3 wickets
-- That gives 8/3 = 2.67 average
-- AC Gilchrist has 0/1 = 0.0 average, which is the lowest
-- 
-- The question asks "Which bowler has the lowest bowling average per wicket taken?"
-- AC Gilchrist is the answer with 0.0 average.
-- 
-- Let me return just the bowler name as requested
SELECT p.player_name
FROM (
    SELECT 
        b.bowler,
        COUNT(*) as wickets,
        SUM(COALESCE(bs.runs_scored, 0)) as total_runs
    FROM ball_by_ball b
    LEFT JOIN batsman_scored bs ON b.match_id = bs.match_id 
        AND b.over_id = bs.over_id 
        AND b.ball_id = bs.ball_id
        AND b.innings_no = bs.innings_no
    LEFT JOIN wicket_taken w ON b.match_id = w.match_id 
        AND b.over_id = w.over_id 
        AND b.ball_id = w.ball_id
        AND b.innings_no = w.innings_no
    GROUP BY b.bowler
    HAVING COUNT(w.player_out) > 0
) stats
JOIN player p ON stats.bowler = p.player_id
WHERE stats.wickets > 0
ORDER BY stats.total_runs * 1.0 / stats.wickets ASC
LIMIT 1;

function.arguments:
{"sql": "-- Bowling average = total runs conceded / total wickets taken
-- First, let's understand the data: count wickets per bowler and total runs conceded per bowler

-- Count wickets per bowler
WITH bowler_wickets AS (
    SELECT 
        b.bowler,
        COUNT(*) as wickets
    FROM ball_by_ball b
    INNER JOIN wicket_taken w ON b.match_id = w.match_id AND b.over_id = w.over_id AND b.ball_id = w.ball_id
    GROUP BY b.bowler
)

-- Total runs conceded per bowler (runs scored off their deliveries)
, bowler_runs AS (
    SELECT 
        b.bowler,
        SUM(bs.runs_scored) as total_runs
    FROM ball_by_ball b
    INNER JOIN batsman_scored bs ON b.match_id = bs.match_id AND b.over_id = bs.over_id AND b.ball_id = bs.ball_id
    GROUP BY b.bowler
)

SELECT 
    bw.bowler,
    p.player_name,
    bw.wickets,
    COALESCE(br.total_runs, 0) as total_runs_conceded,
    CASE 
        WHEN bw.wickets > 0 THEN COALESCE(br.total_runs, 0) * 1.0 / bw.wickets
        ELSE NULL 
    END as bowling_average
FROM bowler_wickets bw
JOIN player p ON bw.bowler = p.player_id
LEFT JOIN bowler_runs br ON bw.bowler = br.bowler
WHERE bw.wickets > 0
ORDER BY bowling_average ASC
LIMIT 20;", "preview_rows": 20}
